correctness.rationale: The divisor exponents identify B_n with ⊗_i L_{a_i}, L_a zero off final row and column (all ones there); local nonzero eigenvalues solve x²−x−a=0 and a−1 kernel directions. Multiplicativity gives 2^r nonzero signed products, τ(n)−2^r zeros and balanced inertia for r≥1. Largest modulus eigenvalue ρ=∏λ_+(a_i) is unique; after normalizing absolute nonzero eigenvalues by ρ the multiset is every subset product of q_i=−λ_−(a_i)/λ_+(a_i)∈(0,1). Greedy multiset deletion of largest available u and its q u determines the unique remaining factor multiset despite repeated products; recover each a_i=q_i/(1−q_i)². This proves exact cospectral-to-prime-exponent/lattice rigidity, with n=1 empty tensor case and zero-padded full n×n form. Independently checked exact integer traces/ranks for n=1,2,4,6,12,18,36,72,96,500, including noncospectral same-size examples; bounded checks supplement exact tensor and inverse proof.
